scope: One 120 V L/N/PE printer enclosure. User confirmed only the five checked equipment groups are on hand; all other enclosure materials are to buy or fabricate. Quantities are per assembly, not vendor pack quantities. Purchase candidates are not a released construction BOM; no orders placed.

items.item: Power logger / 电能记录仪
items.reason: Reuse the photographed instrument. The model uses the published 216 × 63 × 47 mm body; measure this unit before making its cradle.
items.status: On hand · confirmed by user and photos; dimensions still to measure

items.item: Current sensor / 电流传感器
items.reason: Reuse one compatible sensor on printer hot only. Read its actual model, current range and output before setting CH1 in ELOG; the photo does not establish these ratings.
items.status: On hand · compatibility and exact model still to verify

items.item: Blue voltage pigtails / 蓝色短接线
items.reason: A1 is the hot voltage tap to L1; A2 and A3 are neutral voltage taps to L2 and N. These are sensing leads, not the printer power conductors or protective earth.
items.status: On hand · user confirmed three; lead ratings and termination acceptance pending

items.item: Full voltage leads / 长测量线
items.reason: Mate with the three blue pigtails and retain the full factory leads. Check connector compatibility, insulation and bend allowance.
items.status: On hand · confirmed by user; no replacement set planned

items.item: AC/DC adapter / 黑色两脚适配器
items.reason: Plug into XA outside the enclosure. Keep the original DC cable intact. Verify the adapter label against the meter input: 6–10 V DC, 500 mA, center positive.
items.status: On hand · user confirmed this is the plug to use; output rating still to verify

items.item: Enclosure / 箱体
items.reason: Gray polycarbonate body with a clear lift-off lid. Selected for connector clearance and lead storage around the long meter. Nominal 16 × 14 × 8 in; use the manufacturer drawing/CAD for real outside dimensions.
items.status: Selected size; physical dry fit pending

items.item: Mounting panel / 安装底板
items.reason: Steel panel, approximately 327 × 374.7 × 1.9 mm. Ordered separately from the box. Provide its own PE bond; do not depend on painted mounting screws.
items.status: Matches selected enclosure

items.item: Q0 operating breaker / 主断路器
items.reason: Panel-mounted, one-pole 15 A candidate with exterior handle. Manufacturer ordering code specifies 50/60 Hz medium delay, stud terminals and the 240 VAC UL 489 / CSA option. Confirm exact suffix, branch-circuit suitability, supply fault level, combined printer + logger load, inrush and switching duty. Do not substitute a DC-only or UL 1077 variant.
items.status: Confirm electrical selection; request price / lead time

items.item: XA adapter receptacle / 适配器专用插座
items.reason: One NEMA 5-15R, 15 A / 125 V receptacle. Existing black two-pin adapter plugs in outside the right wall. Rear terminations stay in the bonded device box. Label ELITEpro ADAPTER ONLY · UNMETERED.
items.status: Confirm adapter clearance and mounting stack

items.item: XA rear device box / 插座背部金属盒
items.reason: 4 × 2.125 × 2.188 in handy-box envelope, about 101.6 × 54 × 55.6 mm. Guards the rear of XA. Include a dedicated PE bond, listed knockout closure(s) and a suitable wire-entry fitting. Wall support remains a fabricated item.
items.status: Confirm yoke / box / support fit

items.item: XA faceplate / 插座面板
items.reason: Single round 1.406 in opening; standard stainless wallplate, approximately 114.3 × 69.9 mm. Fits the single-receptacle concept. Bond accessible metalwork through the approved device/box arrangement.
items.status: Confirm complete stack before cutting wall

items.item: Fv fuse holder / 测量支路保险座
items.reason: Single Class CC DIN fuse-holder candidate for the hot voltage tap before A1. Body approximately 17.5 × 73.9 × 83.2 mm. Holder rating does not specify the required fuse ampere rating. Confirm lead size and termination acceptance.
items.status: Confirm protection / lead acceptance; check distributor lead time before ordering

items.item: Fv fuse / 测量支路熔断器
items.model: Compatible Class CC fuse · value pending
items.reason: Select voltage, ampere, interrupting rating and time characteristic for the exact sensing leads and prospective fault current. KTK-R / FNQ-R / LP-CC are holder-compatible families in the catalog; no particular value has been approved. Fv is passive and adds no operating switch.
items.status: Rating first · no fuse SKU or ampere value released for purchase

links.label: Select rating / buy · Class CC fuses

items.item: Distribution connectors / 接线端子
items.reason: One each for JL and JN; two bridged connectors for JPE and six external PE connections. Use only with permitted copper conductors, sizes and terminations; confirm tinned blue pigtail and protective-bonding suitability. All groups remain separate.
items.status: Confirm conductor / bonding acceptance

items.item: Connector carriers / 端子固定座
items.reason: Secure the connector groups to the backpanel using the carrier's permitted mounting method. 3D carrier envelope is provisional. Add guards as needed; loose connectors must not rely on the wire for support.
items.status: Confirm purchased carrier drawing

items.item: Short DIN rail / 短导轨
items.quantity: 100 mm cut length; buy 1 pack only if no suitable offcut
items.reason: 35 × 7.5 mm steel profile for Fv only; the linked pack contains two 1 m lengths. End stops and fasteners are separate rows below. Deburr, secure and bond the rail. Q0 is panel mounted.
items.status: Cut length to final fit; pack quantity exceeds one-box need

items.item: Mains / printer cord / 输入与输出电源线
items.reason: Candidate 3-conductor flexible cord for input and printer output. Catalog nominal OD is about 9.17 mm; measure actual cord and choose fittings accordingly. Final current rating depends on the complete assembly and use conditions.
items.status: Confirm load, length and actual OD

items.item: Supply plug / 电源输入插头
items.reason: Grounded 15 A / 125 V male supply plug for the 14/3 input cord. Check accepted wire size and jacket OD against the chosen cord.
items.status: Confirm cord acceptance before ordering

items.item: Printer output connector / 打印机输出插座
items.reason: Grounded female cord connector for the measured printer output. The printer connects here; XA is reserved for the meter adapter.
items.status: Confirm cord acceptance before ordering

items.item: Mains / printer strain relief / 电源线密封固定头
items.reason: M20 × 1.5 cable gland candidate for a 6–12 mm cable OD, with correct locknut / sealing parts. Terminate the cord after feeding through. The model uses a provisional envelope, not its drilling dimensions.
items.status: Confirm exact package, OD and wall thickness

items.item: DC / USB split cable entry / 可分式进线头
items.reason: Split entries retain the factory barrel and USB connectors. KT inserts are listed separately below. Confirm supplied locknut/seal, connector transit, wall thickness and strain relief. The 3D shapes are placeholders, not drilling templates.
items.status: Request two individual bodies and matching inserts; verify package contents

items.item: USB data cable / USB 数据线
items.model: StarTech USB2HAB6 · USB-A to USB-B, 6 ft / 1.8 m
items.reason: USB-B fits the logger data port; USB-A needs a compatible host port. Choose a host-compatible cable instead if the ELOG computer only has USB-C. Retain both factory connectors.
items.status: To buy · user confirmed no additional cable on hand; check host port and length

items.item: DIN rail end stops / 导轨挡块
items.reason: Secure both sides of the fuse holder on the 35 mm DIN rail. Check remaining rail length with the purchased holder.
items.status: To buy · one pack supplies more than needed

items.item: DC / USB sealing inserts / 线缆密封胶芯
items.model: icotek KT small · bore sizes pending
items.reason: One insert for the measured DC cable and one for the selected USB cable. Request compatibility with KVT 20 / 45024; do not choose the bore from connector size.
items.status: Measure first · specify both cable ODs when requesting the quote

items.item: Internal L / N / PE wire / 箱内火、零、地线
items.quantity: Black, white and green; cut lengths after routing
items.reason: Buy one 6-color kit with 25 ft per spool; use black for hot, white for neutral and green for PE. Includes the PE bridge and separate metalwork bonds. Extra kit colors are spare. Confirm wire/terminal acceptance and assembly ampacity; the blue sensing pigtails do not replace this wire.
items.status: Candidate wire · finalize conductor and insulation selection before cutting

items.item: Ring terminals / 环形压接端子
items.quantity: 2 for Q0 + required PE lug ends; allow spares
items.reason: 16–14 AWG insulated ring terminals; select the #8 or #10 stud hole only after checking the actual breaker and bonding studs. Buy the matching size, not both by default. Linked bottles contain 100. Use the specified crimp tool; do not tin stripped ends with solder.
items.status: Size first · verify stud, conductor, barrel and tool compatibility

items.item: Device-box grounding screw / 插座盒接地螺钉
items.reason: Dedicated grounding screw candidate for the metal XA box. Match the box ground hole and terminal. The panel and rail need their own approved bonding fasteners, listed separately; painted mounting screws are not a substitute.
items.status: Confirm box ground-hole thread and engagement

items.item: Rear-box wire-entry protection / 插座盒护线圈
items.quantity: 1 entry; final fitting subject to approval
items.reason: Candidate edge protection for a 22.2 mm opening in the rear metal box, inside the outer enclosure. Check actual sheet thickness, conductor bundle and retention; this grommet is not strain relief or a substitute for any required listed wiring fitting.
items.status: Fit / wiring-method review first · replace candidate if the approved entry needs a clamp

items.item: Unused-opening closures / 备用敲落孔封堵
items.quantity: Only for opened, unused 1/2 in trade knockouts
items.reason: Close any unused knockout that has been removed. Leave intact factory knockouts intact; this is a conditional spare, not an instruction to open extra holes.
items.status: Conditional purchase · count opened unused holes after fabrication

items.item: Screw-fixed cable mounts / 螺钉式线缆固定座
items.quantity: Routing allowance: 8–12; finalize during dry fit
items.reason: Screw-mounted bases for the retained leads and separate power/signal routes. Match #8 / M4 fasteners to the mounting stack. Do not rely on adhesive alone. Linked package contains 100.
items.status: To buy · estimated count, no mounting-hole pattern released

items.item: Cable ties / 扎带
items.reason: For small wire bundles and the screw-fixed bases. Keep allowed bend radii and avoid crushing insulation. This length is for cables, not a strap around the meter.
items.status: To buy · final count after lead routing

items.item: Wire and component labels / 线号与部件标签
items.quantity: 1 SWD dispenser + 1 SLW dispenser; pens included
items.reason: SWD for smaller wire IDs; SLW for larger cables and longer identification. Match actual cable OD to the 3M size table. Mark both wire ends and Q0, JL, JN, PE, Fv, CT1 and A1/A2/A3. Add durable SUPPLY, PRINTER OUTPUT, Q0 ON/OFF and ELITEpro ADAPTER ONLY — UNMETERED legends.
items.status: To buy · confirm label size and adhesion on each surface

items.item: Mounting and bonding hardware / 紧固与接地连接件
items.quantity: 1 matched set; count from final mounting schedule
items.model: Machine screws, nuts, flat/locking washers and approved bonding hardware
items.reason: Cover the DIN rail, four carriers, tie bases, logger restraint, Q0 support, XA box and faceplate stack. Include separate panel and rail PE bolt/lug connections. Check hardware included with each part before ordering duplicates.
items.status: Size first · final thread, length, count and bonding method depend on actual parts

links.label: Select / buy machine screws · Bolt Depot
Select matching nuts / washers · Bolt Depot

items.item: Q0 / XA wall supports / 断路器与插座安装支架
items.reason: Support Q0 on the front wall and XA / rear box on the right wall. Confirm wall taper, thickness, load and electrical insulation requirements. The illustrated inserts are envelopes, not fabrication drawings.
items.status: Custom fabrication · final drawing and material must precede a quote

items.item: Q0 terminal guard / 断路器端子防护罩
items.model: Custom guard or manufacturer-approved terminal covers
items.reason: Prevent contact with Q0 studs and keep the mains terminals separated from signal cables. Use an approved insulating material and fastening scheme; ordinary hobby-print plastic has not been specified. Include any further covers required by the termination review.
items.status: Custom fabrication · geometry, material and clearances still to be released

items.item: Logger cradle and straps / 记录仪固定座与绑带
items.model: Custom cradle + VELCRO ONE-WRAP 91808 roll candidate
items.reason: Hold the long logger without drilling its housing or loading its connectors. Fix the cradle mechanically to the panel; cut straps from the roll with adequate overlap. Confirm material, retention and access to all ports.
items.status: Custom cradle and strap fit pending · not validated as a restraint

inventory_basis: User confirmation on 2026-09-19: ELITEpro XC, existing CTs, three blue voltage pigtails, matching long voltage leads, and the original black two-pin AC/DC adapter only. USB cable and all other enclosure materials are not on hand.

setup_requirements.action: Download / install; no separate software purchase
setup_requirements.reason: Use DENT ELOG for configuration, recording and data retrieval. Installation on the lab computer has not been verified.

setup_requirements.item: ELOG computer and printer under test
setup_requirements.reason: Need a supported Windows computer with a matching USB port and the printer with its original grounded cord. These are setup resources, not checked as owned or counted as enclosure purchases; no replacement printer or computer has been selected.

Calipers, wire stripper, terminal-matched crimper, torque tools, machining/deburring tools, PE/polarity/insulation test equipment and an independent power reference. Arrange access before assembly; tool ratings and procedures belong to the approved build process.
